name: Approach controller
design: Tall slender adult female with pale ash-speckled hide, narrow face and four fine mandibles, long thin dreadlocks tied high. Long navy-charcoal fitted vest with asymmetric grey shoulder shawl, copper chest clasp, split hip panels over close woven trousers. Holds a compact ring-shaped navigation receiver at waist, separate stylus in other hand. Small earpiece attached along head ridge, no helmet, attentive neutral stance.
